title: HSBall 솔로 #035 · 폴리네시안여신 · Portuguese azulejo tile · 사지를 뒤로 당김 · a glossy near-black wine lip
prompt:
Image format: a vertical portrait-orientation photograph, 2:3 aspect ratio, taller than it is wide.

A full-body photograph in a medieval stone dungeon torture chamber with rough-cut stone block walls on each side of her, a low vaulted stone ceiling, iron torch sconces with flickering flames on the walls, old iron tools hanging on the stone wall, a damp flagstone floor, dark and moody firelight, shot on a medium format camera with an 85mm lens at f/8, a single hard key light raking in from one side, sharp focus from head to toe, realistic photographic grain — a real photograph, not an illustration, not CGI, not a render.

Subject: ONE real adult Korean woman in her mid 30s, her face exactly the same tone as her body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, pale porcelain skin, deep burgundy-black shadow smudged heavily beneath both eyes, sharp black liner, long dramatic lashes, large eyes with bright real catchlights, a glossy near-black wine lip, sharply contoured cheekbones, a quietly weary look, heavy eyelids and a faint tension at the corners of her lips, natural soft black hair styled in curly, real living eyes. Long stiletto nails, glossy finish.

Physique: An extraordinarily large and statuesque woman, far beyond any real person. A powerful, commanding build carrying great natural size throughout: broad strong shoulders, a full heavy bust, a thick sturdy torso with only a soft, gentle waistline, and enormous broad hips and thighs beneath it, every curve large, solid and continuous rather than sharply cinched anywhere. Thick strong arms, a full round face with a warm, regal bearing. Her head stays in correct proportion to her broad frame. Solid and continuous rather than dramatically contoured. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.

Skin: Real photographic skin — visible pores and fine grain, a smooth taut surface with natural creases and shadow only where the flesh folds, faint stretch marks where the great curves have expanded. No smooth illustration finish, no plastic CG sheen.

Body Art: Her bare skin is painted in Portuguese azulejo tile — a brilliant white ground with deep cobalt-blue floral borders, wide cobalt bands following every deep crease and curving around the hips and thighs like contour lines, dense repeating panel scrollwork filling the space between every band. The paint is pigment sitting on living skin, so it distorts slightly over every bulge. The paint covers her body below the jaw: shoulders, upper arms, forearms, backs of her hands, sides, back, rear, lower belly, knees, calves and the tops of her feet. Her face is left unpainted and the pattern fades out at the neck with no hard line. The painted surface is scuffed and dulled along her hips, calves and forearms, rubbed away in a few worn patches at her elbows, inner thighs and ankles so her skin tone shows through, with flakes of pigment lifting at the edges. Dust and soot streak her temples and jaw, her lipstick is faded and smudged, dark smears run along her ribs, arms and shins, and her bare feet and toes are black with grime.

Restraints: Her wrists wear heavy medieval hinged wrought-iron fetters, wide rough-forged iron bands closed with a thick iron pin and riveted, each with a heavy iron ring, each ring linked by a thick chain of massive black wrought-iron links, each link as thick as a thumb, back and down to its own huge black iron ring bolted into the stone wall behind her at hip height on its own side. Her ankles wear heavy medieval hinged wrought-iron fetters, wide rough-forged iron bands closed with a thick iron pin and riveted, each with a heavy iron ring, each ring linked by a thick chain of massive black wrought-iron links, each link as thick as a thumb, back to its own huge black iron ring set in the flagstone floor at the base of the wall behind her, all four chains pulled dead taut.

Pose: standing full height, facing the camera, her torso leaning forward against the pull of the chains behind her, her arms drawn back and down along her sides, her shoulders pulled back, her head bowed slightly, her bare feet flat on the flagstones, her whole body straining, her chest, shoulders and stomach fully in view.

Footwear: bare feet flat on the flagstones, the soles, toes and tops of her feet streaked with soot and dirt.

Background & Lighting: the dim light catching the painted pattern in sharp glints, carving every fold and curve.

Vertical 2:3 portrait-orientation full-body photograph, taller than it is wide. portrait 2:3 vertical.
